scope: Original anonymous memory-file creation: common source/solo ABI, original FD reservation and inode admission, native backing creation outside the filesystem lock, retained completion/cancellation and sparse/lifetime accounting.

architecture.import_: MemfdParameters owns one imported name and flags. Source/solo share validation and canonical name-access/length/flag/FD/inode error order. Completion never rereads guest name memory.
architecture.resources: Existing FileWork retains original Files, filesystem, credentials and shared budget. It needs no pathname operands, mount administration, copied Files or owner-task projection.
architecture.construction: Reserve the actual shared FD, register a real unpublished inode against its live limit, release the filesystem guard, create anonymous native backing on the existing disk pool, then install under the private inode guard. Failure/unwind drops the inode, descriptor reservation and backing.
architecture.accounting: Empty and one-GiB sparse anonymous files retain the existing physical-budget policy. Writes/mappings charge actual backing; accepted OFD and final inode release retain original lifetime.
architecture.uring: Already caller-owned io_uring backing creation shares the same filesystem-lock split. This is not a newly migrated io_uring setup path.
